items.title: 1.7.5 Electron affinity ke periodic trends (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.7.5, printed page 12, with Quick Check 1.7 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Group mein neeche atom ka size barhta hai; bara electron cloud hone ki wajah se aane wale electron par nucleus ki attraction (kashish) kam hoti hai. Is liye group mein neeche electron affinity aam taur par kam hoti hai. Halogens mein yeh trend nazar aata hai: At < I < Br < F < Cl. Aam taur par period mein baen se daen electron affinity zyada negative hoti jati hai. Pehli wajah: nuclear charge barhta hai jo naye electrons ko zyada mazbooti se kheenchta hai. Doosri wajah: atomic radius kam hota hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Table mein dekhein: halogens (−270 se −349) ki electron affinity alkali metals (−46 se −60) se kahin zyada negative hai, kyun ke halogen ko shell poora karne ke liye sirf ek electron chahiye. Dono groups mein neeche jate hue qeemat kam negative hoti hai; sirf fluorine chlorine se kam hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Oxygen ki 1st electron affinity −141 kJ/mol hai lekin 2nd electron affinity positive hai (kitab yahan +844.0 likhti hai, jab ke 1.7.4 mein +798 kJ/mol). Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Pehla electron neutral oxygen atom mein jata hai; nucleus use kheenchta hai aur energy release (bahar nikalti) hoti hai, is liye qeemat negative hai. Doosra electron pehle se negative O⁻ ion mein dalna parta hai jo use dhakelta hai; is repulsion ko paar karne ke liye energy deni parti hai, is liye qeemat positive hai (+798 kJ mol⁻¹).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Quick Check 1.7(a) mein oxygen ki 2nd electron affinity +844.0 kJ/mol chhapi hai, jab ke kitab khud topic 1.7.4 mein +798 kJ mol⁻¹ deti hai (O²⁻ ke liye kul +657). Yahan +798 istemal karein.

blocks.prompt: b) Nitrogen aur phosphorus mein kis ki electron affinity zyada hai? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Phosphorus ki. Dono ke p subshell aadhe bhare hain, magar nitrogen ka 2p subshell bohat chhota aur tang hai, wahan naye electron ko pehle se maujood electrons se zyada repulsion milti hai. Phosphorus ka 3p subshell bara hai, is liye naye electron ko kam repulsion hoti hai aur us ki electron affinity zyada hai (nitrogen ki taqreeban zero ke qareeb hai).

blocks.prompt: c) F ka size Cl se chhota hai, phir bhi us ki electron affinity Cl se kam kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Chhota size aam taur par zyada attraction deta hai, lekin fluorine ka 2p subshell itna chhota hai ke pehle se maujood saat electrons naye electron ko zor se dhakelte hain, aur yeh repulsion attraction ko kam kar deti hai. Chlorine ke bare 3p subshell mein jagah zyada hai, is liye woh zyada energy release karti hai (−349 vs −328 kJ/mol).

items: Group mein neeche electron affinity kam (At < I < Br < F < Cl); period mein baen se daen zyada negative.
